data.description:
Add a gitignore coverage reminder to migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh after sentinel creation, and update its test suite.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE (modifying script and test created by S2)

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
- tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh

## Change to migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
After the sentinel file is created (after the line that writes .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated), add:

```bash
# Remind operator to git-add the sentinel if .gitignore may exclude .claude/
_gitignore="$REPO_ROOT/.gitignore"
if [[ -f "$_gitignore" ]] && grep -qE '(^|/)\.claude(/|$|\*|\.conf)' "$_gitignore" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "DSO migration: WARNING: .gitignore may exclude .claude/ — run 'git add .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated' to commit the sentinel. Do NOT commit the sentinel until S6 legacy-reference cleanup is merged." >&2
fi
```

## New Test Function to Add to tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh
test_migrator_emits_sentinel_gitignore_reminder
- Given: REPO_ROOT has a .gitignore containing ".claude/" AND legacy config (merge.strategy=pr)
- When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh runs to completion
- Then: stderr contains "git add .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated"

Also add the negative case:
test_migrator_no_gitignore_reminder_when_claude_not_ignored
- Given: REPO_ROOT has a .gitignore that does NOT mention .claude/
- When: bash migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh runs
- Then: stderr does NOT contain "git add .claude/.dso-config-v2-migrated"

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies:
- DD3: migrator emits reminder to git add sentinel when .gitignore covers .claude/

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_migrator_emits_sentinel_gitignore_reminder passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASS.*sentinel_gitignore_reminder'
- [ ] test_migrator_no_gitignore_reminder_when_claude_not_ignored passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASS.*no_gitignore_reminder'
- [ ] Full test suite passes: bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-dso-workflow-config.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
